mapper.select: SELECT id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, message_id, scene, execute_time, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, error_msg FROM message_dispatch_task WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND ( (status = 'INIT' AND execute_time <= NOW()) OR ( status = 'FAILED' AND retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} AND next_retry_time IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_time <= NOW() ) ) ORDER BY execute_time ASC, create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
